references.text: Both verses are part of the same literary unit in Genesis 5 that uses a fixed formula to emphasize that death is the inevitable end of human life, regardless of lifespan.
As the last in the line before the flood, Lamech's death confirms with the same formula as Mahalalel's that no one in the pre-flood genealogy escaped the judgment of death.
Both verses use the same fixed formula to demonstrate that death is the inevitable end for each individual in Adam's lineage, regardless of lifespan.
The connection between the patriarch Adam and his descendant Mahalalel emphasizes that death is the common fate for all humanity, regardless of lineage.
